SELECT sp.id AS sourceProductId, sp.source_product_name AS sourceProductName, sp.source_product_code AS sourceProductCode, sp.head_img_url AS headImgUrl, sp.category_name AS categoryName, sp.quality_grade AS qualityGrade, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN icl.change_amount < 0 THEN -icl.change_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sold, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN icl.change_amount > 0 THEN icl.change_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS restocked, COALESCE(SUM(-icl.change_amount), 0) AS netChange, COUNT(icl.id) AS changeCount, MAX(icl.create_time) AS lastChangeTime FROM source_product sp LEFT JOIN inventory_change_log icl ON icl.source_product_id = sp.id WHERE sp.is_deleted = 0 AND (sp.quality_grade IN ('A','B') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM source_factory f WHERE f.id = sp.source_factory_id AND f.is_deleted=0 AND f.quality_grade IN ('A','B')))
AND (icl.create_time >= #{beginTime} OR icl.id IS NULL)
AND (icl.create_time <= #{endTime} OR icl.id IS NULL)
GROUP BY sp.id, sp.source_product_name, sp.source_product_code, sp.head_img_url, sp.category_name, sp.quality_grade ORDER BY sold DESC
